CAREER OBJECTIVE
Highly accomplished computer science professor with over 20 years of experience teaching at the
university level, seeking a full time position which is research and industry oriented to enable improve
technological standards in overall learning community. Demonstrated excellence in teaching and
research, and a strong commitment to student success.

TEACHING EXPERIENCE
 Department of Computer Science, Gujarat University, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
August 2011 – Present
o Provided comprehensive academic support to the head of the Department of
Computer Science.
o Taught MCA(Masters of Computer Application students) – masters course averaging
40 students per semester covering following topics: Database Management Systems,
Java Programming and Full stack Development
Bhumika Shah - 1
o Taught M.Sc(Masters in Science-Computer Science) students) – undergraduate course
averaging 120 students per semester covering following topics: HTML, CSS, JavaScript,
Database management system and Front end web development.
o Developed quizzes, exams, and homework
o Revised the syllabus to meet accreditation standards
o Designed the new syllabus as per the new education policy (NEP 2020)
o Served as a student counselor (mentor) for incoming freshman students.
o Designed syllabi for the M.Sc. course, specializing in subjects like Database
Management Systems, Java Programming, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and more.
o Represented the department at international conferences and academic events,
fostering networking and collaboration opportunities.
o Organized state and national-level workshops, seminars, and events to enhance the
learning experience of students.
o Deliver engaging lectures and tutorials for both undergraduate and graduate students,
employing effective teaching methodologies.
o Actively involved in writing research funding proposals, contributing to the
department's research initiatives.
o Provide guidance and mentorship to project students, assisting them with their
dissertations and project work.
o Oversee the entire placement process for graduating batches, ensuring successful
career opportunities for students.
o Design pedagogy for all STEM courses, promoting innovative and effective teaching
practices.
 Department of Computer Science, IBMR College, Pune, Maharashtra
January 2006 - March 2011
o Conducted lectures and tutorials for undergraduate and graduate students, delivering

o Represented the department at international conferences and academic events,
fostering professional growth and knowledge exchange.
o Organized state and national-level workshops, seminars, and events to enhance
students' learning experience.
o Managed the entire placement process for graduating batches, facilitating successful

o Provided mentorship and guidance to project students, supporting them in their
dissertations and project work.

sections.text:
RESEARCH EXPERIENCE
 Developed GU_DB, a Database system Prototype, integrated with Virtual laboratory as a front end.
Published a paper in the International Journal of Advanced Computer Research.
 Integrated GU_DB with Automated Assessment of SQL Queries and published the work in FICTA-2021,
NIT Mizoram.
 Conducted research on Image processing for training image pixels, resulting in the publication of the
work on ImageGPT with Super resolution in February 2022.
 Extensive work on Query Optimization in various contexts.
 Created an Innovative Framework for Remote Database Experimentation, integrating it with Learning
Management Systems hosted at IIT-B portal.
Bhumika Shah - 2
 Proposed efficient retrieval in Multi-lingual systems for E-Governance resources, published in IEEE,
ICTBIG'16.
 Developed an innovative approach for sub-query optimization, published in a Springer Conference, UK,
2018.
